page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Additionally, the instance includes 2835 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across compute and memory operations. The server achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, as well as PassMark CPU and memory evaluations. Memory bandwidth for cached small blocks is highly efficient at 3648.86 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds drop to average levels of 114.93 GB/sec and 83.19 GB/sec respectively. Cryptographic and vector instruction performance is strong, aided by hardware support for AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI. Database operations and Redis SET performance are highly competitive, with Redis reaching 67.13 million operations per second.

While the E48ads_v6 excels at memory-intensive tasks and small-to-medium model LLM inference, it exhibits limitations in large-scale AI workloads. Text generation for a large 70B LLM model is weak, averaging only 2.59 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. However, the combination of high memory density, fast local storage, and strong multi-threaded decompression makes this instance highly cost-efficient for relational databases, in-memory caching, software compilation, and data-dense enterprise workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 24-core AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz, delivering 48 dedicated vCPUs. It features 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside 2835 GB of local SSD storage. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and VAES. Benchmark data shows strong performance in multi-core processing, database operations, and Redis caching, though uncached memory bandwidth and large-scale LLM text generation represent performance tradeoffs. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, relational databases, and in-memory data stores.
